note: Fulton County (IN) zoning districts are published as a PDF Zone Map (Fulton County Zone Map, 2008 ordinance) by the county Plan Commission, which also handles zoning for Rochester, Akron and Kewanna. No ArcGIS REST zoning districts layer was found: the county's ArcGIS Online web map (Fulton_Parcels, Muni_Boundaries, Road_Centerlines, Flood layers) has no zoning layer, the parcel layer has no zoning field, and the county GIS viewer (WTHGIS) exposes no REST services. Third-party zoneomics pages are not official sources.
